purpose: The clone space for cloneable machines (localAssetStorageStack#8). Engines recognise cloneable machines when they load the corpus, by the rule in RealityEngine_CI SURFACE_SPEC.md (RealityEngine_CI#713); nothing is written into machine files. An engine clones one of them once per dispatch envelope, into one block of this band, at the machine's initial state, and recycles the clone when its agentic action completes. scripts/cloneable_machines.py checks this file against the reserved range and reports which machines qualify.

block.note: Each clone owns one block: its ISRE half holds its input and its OSRE half its output, so no two clones share a cell (the contended-cell rule).

slotRule: A machine fits a block when its input length <= isreCells, its output length <= osreCells, and n = (cells its fanout folds into, over its published-domain-bus-producer edges) + busCells <= isreCells. Document-workflow handoffs carry the assetID and fold no cells. A machine may opt out with metadata.cloneable: false.

band.note: 1024 blocks per engine instance, above the corpus footprint. Blocks are allocated by the engine, lowest free first, so engines with identical corpora place identical clones identically.

activeClones.note: The upper bound on active clones of one template on one engine instance. It is configurable and managed at run time through /api/engine/config; the band bounds the total.
